body.message:
You may share the guest details with us so we can proceed with creating the booking.

For the booking process, we require the following:

Copy of the guest’s ID or passport
Email address
Contact number

Once received, we will share the payment link or bank details accordingly to confirm the booking.

After the booking is confirmed, we will share the Booking confirmation so you may update your CRM or coordinate with your admin for the further process.

Thank you.
